nodes.name: Acknowledge Immediately
nodes.notes: Meta requires a 200 within a few seconds or it retries/disables the webhook. Ack first, then keep processing in the background execution.

nodes.name: Has Inbound Message?
nodes.notes: Meta also sends 'statuses' webhook events (delivered/read receipts) on the same path. Only proceed for actual inbound messages, ignore status callbacks.

nodes.name: Split Into One Message Per Item
nodes.notes: Added 2026-08-13 after an audit found every downstream node hardcoded messages[0], silently dropping messages[1], messages[2] etc. Meta's webhook payload can legitimately batch more than one message in a single call (e.g. after a connectivity gap is resolved and queued messages are delivered together). This node turns that array into one n8n item per message (in field 'message'), with include set to allOtherFields so contacts/metadata/phone_number_id stay available on every split item (Split Out's default is to drop everything except the split field, easy to miss).

nodes.name: Extract Message Fields
nodes.notes: messageType is one of 'text', 'image', 'audio' (voice notes arrive as type 'audio' with voice=true inside the audio object, same media/id shape). mediaId is populated for image or audio messages, empty for text. Sticker, video, and document messages are not handled here yet, same 'unsupported type' fallback below covers them.

parameters.query: SELECT id FROM messages WHERE wa_message_id = $1

nodes.name: Check for Duplicate Delivery
nodes.notes: Added 2026-08-13 after an audit found Meta's Cloud API uses at-least-once webhook delivery (retries for up to 7 days on any slow/failed response), meaning the same inbound message can legitimately arrive twice. wa_message_id (requires supabase/migrations/005_message_dedup.sql) is Meta's own dedup key. If a message with this id was already logged, stop here rather than generating and sending a second AI reply.

nodes.name: Already Processed?
nodes.notes: True branch (duplicate found): dead-ends intentionally, Meta already got its 200 from Acknowledge Immediately, nothing more to do. False branch (new message): continues to the normal pipeline.

parameters.query:
SELECT c.id, c.business_name, c.industry, c.config, wn.id AS whatsapp_number_id
FROM customers c
JOIN customer_whatsapp_numbers wn ON wn.customer_id = c.id
WHERE wn.whatsapp_number = $1

nodes.name: Load Customer by Number
nodes.notes: phone_number_id from Meta's payload must match a row in customer_whatsapp_numbers.whatsapp_number exactly. A customer can have more than one number, this join finds the owning customer regardless of which of their numbers received the message. whatsapp_number_id (added 2026-08-12, requires supabase/migrations/004_conversation_number_attribution.sql) is this specific number's own row id, used below to attribute the conversation to it, not just to the customer as a whole. industry and config (added 2026-08-21, requires supabase/migrations/009_customer_config.sql) feed Build System Prompt below; config defaults to '{}'::jsonb for any customer not yet configured at onboarding.

nodes.name: Customer Found?
nodes.notes: If no customer row matches this WhatsApp number, stop. Don't guess or default to some other customer's data.

assignments.name: systemPrompt
assignments.value:
={{ [ 'You are the WhatsApp assistant for ' + $('Load Customer by Number').item.json.business_name + ', a Voxitron customer.', ($('Load Customer by Number').item.json.config || {}).tone_notes ? 'Tone: ' + $('Load Customer by Number').item.json.config.tone_notes : null, Array.isArray(($('Load Customer by Number').item.json.config || {}).qualification_questions) && $('Load Customer by Number').item.json.config.qualification_questions.length ? 'Before helping further, try to learn:
' + $('Load Customer by Number').item.json.config.qualification_questions.map(q => '- ' + q).join('
') : null, (($('Load Customer by Number').item.json.config || {}).booking_flow || {}).instructions ? 'Booking/ordering: ' + $('Load Customer by Number').item.json.config.booking_flow.instructions : null, Array.isArray(($('Load Customer by Number').item.json.config || {}).escalation_triggers) && $('Load Customer by Number').item.json.config.escalation_triggers.length ? 'Hand off to a human (do not attempt to answer yourself) if:
' + $('Load Customer by Number').item.json.config.escalation_triggers.map(t => '- ' + t).join('

If the answer is not in the knowledge base, say you will have someone from the team follow up.', 'Write like a real person texting on WhatsApp: short sentences, no markdown formatting, no bullet points, no em dashes. Two to three sentences per reply unless the question genuinely needs more.' ].filter(Boolean).join('

') }}

nodes.name: Build System Prompt
nodes.notes: Added 2026-08-21. Assembles this customer's system prompt from customers.config (supabase/migrations/009_customer_config.sql), so AI Agent Reply's behavior is per-customer/per-industry instead of one hardcoded string for everyone. config defaults to '{}'::jsonb for a customer not yet configured at onboarding (see supabase/onboarding-template.sql Step 1.5), every field access is guarded so that degrades to just the business name plus the fixed platform-level rules (KB-first, WhatsApp-texting style), never to literal 'undefined' text in the prompt. Fires once per message on the Customer Found? true branch, before the media/text split, so both branches can reference it by name the same way they already reference Merge Message Text.

nodes.name: Is Image or Voice Note?
nodes.notes: Text messages skip straight to the existing pipeline unchanged. Image and audio messages route through the download-and-transcribe/describe branch below before rejoining at Get or Create Conversation.

nodes.name: Is Text?
nodes.notes: Reached only when Is Image or Voice Note? found no mediaId, meaning the message is either plain text or an unsupported type this workflow doesn't handle at all (video, document, sticker, location, contact card, etc., added 2026-08-12). True branch is the existing text path. False branch escalates to a human instead of silently dropping the message the way it did before this check existed.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO conversations (customer_id, contact_name, contact_phone, whatsapp_number_id)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3, $4::uuid)
ON CONFLICT (customer_id, contact_phone)
DO UPDATE SET whatsapp_number_id = $4::uuid
RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Load Customer by Number').item.json.id }},{{ $('Extract Message Fields').item.json.contactName }},{{ $('Extract Message Fields').item.json.fromNumber }},{{ $('Load Customer by Number').item.json.whatsapp_number_id }}

nodes.name: Get or Create Conversation (Escalation)
nodes.notes: Same atomic upsert as 'Get or Create Conversation' on the normal path (see its note for why ON CONFLICT replaced the old racy pattern), duplicated as its own node rather than shared, because n8n connections are per-node: sharing one node between both branches would also merge their downstream routing (this branch must not flow into Log Inbound Message / AI Agent Reply). Both nodes independently converge on the same underlying conversations row (same customer_id + contact_phone), so no duplicate conversation is created.

parameters.query:
UPDATE conversations
SET needs_human = true,
    escalation_reason = $2
WHERE id = $1::uuid

nodes.name: Flag Conversation: Needs Human
nodes.notes: Requires supabase/migrations/003_conversation_escalation.sql to be applied first (adds conversations.needs_human, conversations.escalation_reason). No business-owner notification is sent here, confirmed with the user 2026-08-12 as explicitly out of scope for this pass: the dashboard's future conversation list is the only place this flag surfaces today, per DASHBOARD_UI.md.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, direction, body, wa_message_id)
VALUES ($1::uuid, 'inbound', $2, $3)

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Get or Create Conversation (Escalation)').item.json.id }},{{ '[' + $('Extract Message Fields').item.json.messageType + ' message, not yet supported]' }},{{ $('Extract Message Fields').item.json.waMessageId }}

nodes.name: Log Unsupported Inbound Message
nodes.notes: Logs a placeholder body so the conversation thread shows something arrived, instead of a gap. The real content (a video/document/etc.) is never transcribed or described, unlike the image/voice note path above, this type genuinely isn't handled yet. Stores wa_message_id for the same dedup reason as Log Inbound Message.

nodes.name: Send Escalation Reply
nodes.notes: Fixed, non-AI-generated reply, deliberately not routed through the AI Agent since there's nothing for it to reason about (no text, no describable media). Matches the /whatsapp-agent page's existing promise: 'It flags the chat with the full conversation. You take over, and the customer never feels ignored.'

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, direction, body)
VALUES ($1::uuid, 'outbound', $2)

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Get or Create Conversation (Escalation)').item.json.id }},{{ "I can't view that kind of file yet, sorry. I've let our team know, they'll follow up with you shortly." }}

nodes.name: Log Escalation Reply
nodes.notes: Same outbound-logging pattern as Log Outbound Message at the end of the normal AI reply path, kept as a separate node since this branch never reaches AI Agent Reply's output to reuse that node's query.

nodes.name: Get Media URL
nodes.notes: Returns { url, mime_type, sha256, file_size, id }. The url is Meta's lookaside CDN and expires 5 minutes after this call, download it immediately in the next node, don't store or delay on this URL.

nodes.name: Download Media Binary
nodes.notes: Same bearer token as Get Media URL, Meta's CDN checks auth on this request too, it's not a plain pre-signed URL. Output is binary data (this node's response format is 'file'), consumed by whichever of the two nodes below matches the message type.

nodes.name: Image or Audio?
nodes.notes: Splits the downloaded binary to the vision-description path (image) or the transcription path (audio/voice note).

parameters.text: =Describe what's in this photo in one or two plain sentences, focused on anything relevant to a customer inquiry: product, item, damage, quantity, or written text visible in the image. This description will stand in for the customer's message, so be concrete and specific, not vague.

nodes.name: Describe Image (GPT-4o Vision)
nodes.notes: Turns the photo into a text description, which Set Media As Message Text below treats exactly like a typed message. If the customer also sent a caption with the image, that's appended too (see mediaCaption field), so 'here's the shoe I want, do you have size 42?' isn't lost.

nodes.name: Transcribe Voice Note (Whisper)
nodes.notes: WhatsApp voice notes are Opus-encoded .ogg files, Whisper accepts this format directly, no transcoding step needed.

assignments.name: messageText
assignments.value: ={{ $('Extract Message Fields').item.json.messageType === 'image' ? ($json.content || $json.text || '') + ($('Extract Message Fields').item.json.mediaCaption ? ' Caption from customer: ' + $('Extract Message Fields').item.json.mediaCaption : '') : ($json.text || $json.content || '') }}

nodes.name: Resolve Message Text (Media)
nodes.notes: Overwrites messageText with the image description or voice transcript. Feeds into Merge Message Text below, which is the single node downstream code actually references by name, since only one of this node or 'Resolve Message Text (Text)' runs on a given execution.

nodes.name: Resolve Message Text (Text)
nodes.notes: Plain-text messages skip the media pipeline but still pass through a same-shaped node, so both branches can feed the same Merge node below.

nodes.name: Merge Message Text
nodes.notes: Only one of the two inputs ever has data on a given execution (text messages take input 2, image/audio take input 1, IF nodes send the other branch an empty item set), so 'chooseBranch' safely passes through whichever one actually ran. This single node is what every downstream node (Get or Create Conversation, Log Inbound Message, AI Agent Reply) references by name for messageText, avoiding n8n's 'Referenced node is unexecuted' error that would happen referencing either resolve node directly, since only one of them runs per execution.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO conversations (customer_id, contact_name, contact_phone, whatsapp_number_id)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3, $4::uuid)
ON CONFLICT (customer_id, contact_phone)
DO UPDATE SET whatsapp_number_id = $4::uuid
RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Load Customer by Number').item.json.id }},{{ $('Extract Message Fields').item.json.contactName }},{{ $('Extract Message Fields').item.json.fromNumber }},{{ $('Load Customer by Number').item.json.whatsapp_number_id }}

nodes.name: Get or Create Conversation
nodes.notes: Atomic upsert on the (customer_id, contact_phone) unique constraint from supabase/migrations/006_conversation_uniqueness.sql, added 2026-08-13 after an audit found the prior INSERT-WHERE-NOT-EXISTS pattern had a race: two messages from the same contact arriving close together could both pass the existence check before either INSERT committed, creating duplicate conversation rows. ON CONFLICT makes Postgres itself serialize this, no race possible regardless of timing. whatsapp_number_id is refreshed on every message via DO UPDATE, so it always reflects whichever of the customer's numbers most recently received a message from this contact.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, direction, body, wa_message_id)
VALUES ($1::uuid, 'inbound', $2, $3)

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Get or Create Conversation').item.json.id }},{{ $('Merge Message Text').item.json.messageText }},{{ $('Extract Message Fields').item.json.waMessageId }}

nodes.name: Log Inbound Message
nodes.notes: Reads messageText from Merge Message Text, the single node both the text and media branches converge through, so this logs the typed text for text messages and the image description / voice transcript for media messages, whichever branch produced this item. Stores wa_message_id (requires supabase/migrations/005_message_dedup.sql) so Check for Duplicate Delivery can catch a retried webhook for this same message.

nodes.name: AI Agent Reply
nodes.notes: Added 2026-08-13: onError continueErrorOutput plus retryOnFail means a transient failure (OpenAI rate limit, Qdrant briefly down, etc.) retries 3 times, and if it still fails, routes to the AI Failure Fallback branch below instead of silently dying mid-execution and leaving the customer with no reply and no record of why. systemMessage changed 2026-08-21 to read from Build System Prompt (per-customer config) instead of a hardcoded string, see that node's notes.

parameters.query:
UPDATE conversations
SET needs_human = true,
    escalation_reason = 'ai_reply_failed'
WHERE id = $1::uuid

nodes.name: Flag Conversation: AI Failed
nodes.notes: Added 2026-08-13. Reached only when AI Agent Reply exhausts its 3 retries and still fails (OpenAI outage, Qdrant down, etc.). Flags the conversation the same way an unsupported message type does, so it surfaces on the dashboard's future 'needs attention' list.

nodes.name: Send AI Failure Reply
nodes.notes: Added 2026-08-13. Fixed, non-AI-generated apology, since the AI Agent is exactly what just failed. Ensures the customer gets some response rather than silence when the underlying AI call couldn't complete.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, direction, body)
VALUES ($1::uuid, 'outbound', $2)

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Get or Create Conversation').item.json.id }},{{ "Sorry, I'm having trouble right now. I've let our team know, they'll follow up with you shortly." }}

nodes.name: Log AI Failure Reply
nodes.notes: Added 2026-08-13. Same outbound-logging pattern as Log Outbound Message, kept separate since this branch never reaches AI Agent Reply's successful output.

parameters.toolDescription: Search this business's knowledge base (products, pricing, policies) to answer the customer's question. Always use this before replying.

nodes.notes: Collection is namespaced per Voxitron customer (kb_<customers.id>), same pattern as Area50's WF1/WF5/WF6. Not built yet, out of scope for this logging-focused pass.

nodes.notes: Header credential should send 'Authorization: Bearer <permanent Meta access token>'. Token is per Meta app, not per customer, since all customer numbers are typically under one Meta Business Account / WABA.
